onboarding_abstract.description: Abstract neon shapes to use as a background layer in onboarding or hero sections

course_placeholder_1.description: Background for Web Development / HTML track

components_instructions.login_screen: Use a dark, immersive background with the onboarding_abstract image at 30% opacity. Large, chunky Google Auth button at the bottom.
components_instructions.home_screen: Top header must show Streak (flame icon + orange text) and XP. Course tracks presented as large bento-box cards. Avoid equal grids; use 1 full-width featured card, then 2 column cards.
components_instructions.lesson_screen: The code pane must consume ~60% of the screen (darker `#0D1117` background). The theory/instructions in `#161B22` pane above it. Use floating pill-shaped AI autocomplete suggestions.
components_instructions.ai_tutor_screen: Chat interface. User bubbles: `#1E293B`. AI bubbles: `#38BDF8` with dark text. Include a model selector dropdown (Claude 3.5 / GPT-4) styled as a sleek native picker.
components_instructions.code_editor: Must use 'JetBrains Mono'. Must have line numbers styled in muted `#475569`. Action button 'Run Code' must pulse or have high contrast (`#2ACC15`).

testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, course cards) must include 'data-testid' properties formatted in kebab-case (e.g., 'start-lesson-button', 'google-auth-button').
nativewind_compatibility: Ensure class names used here map perfectly to NativeWind utilities. No pseudo-classes like hover: unless supported; use active: for tap feedback.
